```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  eval    = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  results = "asis",
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 5
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE, results="hide"}
# ── Data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# params$data_file is always set when rendered from Shiny.
# list.files() fallback is only for local development.
if (!is.null(params$data_file)) {

  data <- readRDS(params$data_file)

} else {

  local_file <- list.files(pattern = "index_data\\.rds", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(local_file) == 0) stop("No local index_data.rds found for development knit.")
  data <- readRDS(local_file[1])

}

data <- data %>% mutate(severity_value = as.numeric(severity_value))
```

```{r resolve-params, include=FALSE, results="hide"}
# ── Admin boundaries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_possible_admins <- c("admin1", "admin2", "admin3", "admin4")

# Intersect declared bounds with what actually exists as columns
select_admin_bounds <- if (!is.null(params$select_admin_bounds)) {
  params$select_admin_bounds
} else {
  all_possible_admins[all_possible_admins %in% names(data)]
}

admin_boundaries <- all_possible_admins[all_possible_admins %in% select_admin_bounds &
                                          all_possible_admins %in% names(data)]

# Settlement = admin4 present; otherwise lowest level is area (admin3 or less)
has_settlement <- "admin4" %in% admin_boundaries
lowest_admin   <- tail(admin_boundaries, 1)   # e.g. "admin2", "admin3", "admin4"

# ── Admin level for area ranking ──────────────────────────────────────────────
admin_level <- if (!is.null(params$admin_level_index) && length(params$admin_level_index) >= 1) {
  al <- params$admin_level_index[[1]]
  if (al %in% admin_boundaries) al else lowest_admin
} else {
  lowest_admin
}

# ── Methods ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
selected_methods <- if (!is.null(params$selected_index_method) &&
                        length(params$selected_index_method) > 0) {
  params$selected_index_method
} else {
  # Auto-detect from columns present
  if ("flag4"   %in% names(data)) "flag4"
  else if ("flag3" %in% names(data)) "flag3"
  else if ("score_index_settlement" %in% names(data)) "score"
  else stop("Could not detect any supported index method in the data.")
}

# ── Column resolver (mirrors sensitivity analysis Rmd) ────────────────────────
resolve_method_cols <- function(method, df_names) {
  candidates <- list(
    "flag3" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag3",
      settlement_col = "flag3_settlement",
      sector_col     = "flag3_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_flag3_area",
      label          = "Flag 3"
    ),
    "flag4" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag4",
      settlement_col = "flag4_settlement",
      sector_col     = "flag4_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_flag4_area",
      label          = "Flag 4"
    ),
    "flag4+" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag4_plus",
      settlement_col = "flag4_plus_settlement",
      sector_col     = "flag4_plus_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_flag4_plus_area",
      label          = "Flag 4+"
    ),
    "proportion3" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag3",
      settlement_col = "proportion3_settlement",
      sector_col     = "proportion3_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_proportion3_area",
      label          = "Proportion 3"
    ),
    "proportion4" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag4",
      settlement_col = "proportion4_settlement",
      sector_col     = "proportion4_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_proportion4_area",
      label          = "Proportion 4"
    ),
    "proportion4+" = list(
      flag_col       = "flag4_plus",
      settlement_col = "proportion4_plus_settlement",
      sector_col     = "proportion4_plus_sector",
      area_col       = "mean_proportion4_plus_area",
      label          = "Proportion 4+"
    ),
    "score" = list(
      flag_col       = NULL,
      settlement_col = "score_index_settlement",
      sector_col     = "score_index_sector",
      area_col       = "score_index_area",
      label          = "Score Index"
    )
  )

  cols <- if (length(method) == 1L && !is.na(method) && method %in% names(candidates)) {
    candidates[[method]]
  } else {
    found <- NULL
    for (m in names(candidates)) {
      fc <- candidates[[m]]$flag_col
      if (is.null(fc) || (length(fc) == 1L && fc %in% df_names)) { found <- candidates[[m]]; break }
    }
    if (is.null(found)) candidates[[1]] else found
  }

  col_entries <- setdiff(names(cols), "label")
  cols[col_entries] <- lapply(cols[col_entries], function(v) {
    if (is.null(v) || !is.character(v) || length(v) != 1L) return(v)
    if (v %in% df_names) v else NULL
  })
  cols
}

col_exists <- function(col, df = data) !is.null(col) && col %in% names(df)

# ── Shared colour palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
custom_colors <- c(
  "fsl"     = "#F08080",
  "shl"     = "#D2B48C",
  "shelter" = "#D2B48C",
  "wsh"     = "#ADD8E6",
  "wash"    = "#ADD8E6",
  "hea"     = "#DDA0DD",
  "pop"     = "#FFD700",
  "pro"     = "#A9A9A9",
  "cm"      = "#F4A460",
  "edu"     = "#90EE90",
  "aap"     = "#FFB6C1"
)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Render a styled kable
styled_kable <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    knitr::kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      full_width        = FALSE,
      bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")
    )
}

# Horizontal bar chart
bar_chart <- function(df, x_col, y_col, fill_col = NULL, title = "", x_label = "") {
  aes_args <- if (!is.null(fill_col)) {
    aes(x = reorder(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]]),
        y = .data[[y_col]],
        fill = .data[[fill_col]])
  } else {
    aes(x = reorder(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]]),
        y = .data[[y_col]])
  }
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_args) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = x_label, fill = "Sector")
  if (!is.null(fill_col)) p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, na.value = "grey70")
  p
}

# Pretty section divider
section_note <- function(text) cat(paste0("\n> ", text, "\n\n"))
```

---

```{r report-header, results='asis'}
# Summary callout shown at the top of the rendered report
active_labels <- sapply(selected_methods, function(m) {
  resolve_method_cols(m, names(data))$label
})

cat("## Report Summary\n\n")
cat(paste0(
  "| | |\n",
  "|---|---|\n",
  "| **Method(s)** | ", paste(active_labels, collapse = ", "), " |\n",
  "| **Admin levels** | ", paste(admin_boundaries, collapse = " › "), " |\n",
  "| **Area ranking level** | ", admin_level, " |\n",
  "| **Settlement data** | ",
  ifelse(has_settlement, "✔ Available (admin4 present)",
         paste0("✘ Not available — lowest level is ", lowest_admin)),
  " |\n\n"
))
```

---

# Results {.tabset}

## Indicator {.tabset}

Top 10 indicators by severity across all `r lowest_admin` units.

```{r indicator-tabs, results='asis'}
for (method in selected_methods) {

  mc          <- resolve_method_cols(method, names(data))
  flag_col    <- mc$flag_col
  is_flag     <- str_detect(method, "flag")
  is_prop     <- str_detect(method, "proportion")
  label       <- mc$label

  cat(paste0("\n### ", label, "\n\n"))

  # ── Build summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is_flag && col_exists(flag_col)) {

    top_ind <- data %>%
      select(question, sector, all_of(flag_col)) %>%
      group_by(question, sector) %>%
      summarise(value = sum(.data[[flag_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(value)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = 1)

    y_label <- paste("# units flagged —", label)

  } else {

    # proportion or score: mean of severity_value
    top_ind <- data %>%
      select(question, sector, severity_value) %>%
      group_by(question, sector) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(severity_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(value)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(
        Rank  = row_number(), .before = 1,
        value = round(value, 2)
      )

    y_label <- paste("Mean severity value —", label)

  }

  # ── Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  top_ind %>%
    rename(Indicator = question, Sector = sector, !!y_label := value) %>%
    styled_kable() %>%
    cat()

  cat("\n\n")

  # ── Chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- bar_chart(top_ind, x_col = "question", y_col = "value",
                 fill_col = "sector",
                 title    = paste("Top Indicators —", label),
                 x_label  = y_label)
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Sector {.tabset}

Severity aggregated to sector level.

```{r sector-tabs, results='asis'}
for (method in selected_methods) {

  mc         <- resolve_method_cols(method, names(data))
  sector_col <- mc$sector_col
  label      <- mc$label
  is_flag    <- str_detect(method, "flag")

  cat(paste0("\n### ", label, "\n\n"))

  if (!col_exists(sector_col)) {
    cat(paste0("*Column `", sector_col, "` not found in data.*\n\n"))
    next
  }

  top_sec <- data %>%
    select(all_of(admin_boundaries), sector, all_of(sector_col)) %>%
    distinct()

  if (is_flag) {

    top_sec <- top_sec %>%
      group_by(sector) %>%
      summarise(value = sum(.data[[sector_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(value)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = 1)

    y_label <- paste("# units flagged —", label)

  } else {

    # proportion / score: include error messages where available
    has_err <- "error_message_sector" %in% names(data)

    top_sec <- data %>%
      select(all_of(admin_boundaries), sector, all_of(sector_col),
             any_of("error_message_sector")) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      group_by(sector) %>%
      summarise(
        value         = mean(.data[[sector_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        error_message = if (has_err) max(error_message_sector, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_character_,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        display = ifelse(
          is.na(value),
          error_message,
          paste0(round(value, 2), if (str_detect(method, "proportion")) " %" else "")
        )
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(value)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = 1)

    y_label <- paste("Mean —", label)

  }

  # ── Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tbl_sec <- if (is_flag) {
    top_sec %>% rename(Sector = sector, !!y_label := value)
  } else {
    top_sec %>%
      select(Rank, Sector = sector, !!y_label := display) %>%
      select(-any_of("error_message"))
  }

  tbl_sec %>% styled_kable() %>% cat()
  cat("\n\n")

  # ── Chart (numeric only) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  chart_data <- if (is_flag) top_sec else top_sec %>% filter(!is.na(value))

  if (nrow(chart_data) > 0) {
    p <- bar_chart(chart_data, x_col = "sector", y_col = "value",
                   fill_col = "sector",
                   title    = paste("Sector Severity —", label),
                   x_label  = y_label)
    print(p)
  }

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## `r if (has_settlement) "Settlement" else paste("Area (", lowest_admin, ")", sep="")` {.tabset}

```{r settlement-area-intro, results='asis'}
if (has_settlement) {
  cat("Top 10 units at **settlement level** (admin4).\n\n")
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    "> ⚠️ **No settlement data:** `admin4` is not present. ",
    "Showing results at the **", lowest_admin, "** level instead.\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r settlement-tabs, results='asis'}
for (method in selected_methods) {

  mc    <- resolve_method_cols(method, names(data))
  label <- mc$label

  # Use settlement col if available, otherwise fall back to area col
  rank_col <- if (has_settlement && col_exists(mc$settlement_col)) {
    mc$settlement_col
  } else if (col_exists(mc$area_col)) {
    mc$area_col
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  cat(paste0("\n### ", label, "\n\n"))

  if (is.null(rank_col)) {
    cat(paste0("*No suitable column found for method `", method, "`.*\n\n"))
    next
  }

  # Group columns: either all admin_boundaries (settlement) or up to lowest_admin (area)
  group_cols <- if (has_settlement) admin_boundaries else admin_boundaries

  top_units <- data %>%
    select(all_of(group_cols), all_of(rank_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[rank_col]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = 1)

  col_label <- if (has_settlement) {
    paste("Settlement value —", label)
  } else {
    paste(lowest_admin, "value —", label)
  }

  top_units %>%
    rename(!!col_label := all_of(rank_col)) %>%
    styled_kable() %>%
    cat()

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Area {.tabset}

Top 10 areas at the **`r admin_level`** level.

```{r area-tabs, results='asis'}
for (method in selected_methods) {

  mc       <- resolve_method_cols(method, names(data))
  area_col <- mc$area_col
  label    <- mc$label

  cat(paste0("\n### ", label, "\n\n"))

  if (!col_exists(area_col)) {
    cat(paste0("*Column `", area_col, "` not found for method `", method, "`.*\n\n"))
    next
  }

  top_areas <- data %>%
    select(all_of(admin_level), all_of(area_col)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[area_col]])) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = 1)

  area_label <- paste("Area value —", label)

  top_areas %>%
    rename(!!area_label := all_of(area_col)) %>%
    styled_kable() %>%
    cat()

  cat("\n\n")

  # ── Lollipop chart — cleaner than bars for area-level ranking ─────────────
  p <- ggplot(top_areas,
              aes(x = reorder(.data[[admin_level]], .data[[area_col]]),
                  y = .data[[area_col]])) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = .data[[admin_level]], yend = 0),
                 colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(colour = "#2C7BB6", size = 4) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Top Areas —", label, "(", admin_level, ")"),
         x = "", y = area_label)

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
